equivalence_rule: 90% CI for paired mean loss difference A-Tk entirely inside [-0.02,+0.02] => EQUIVALENT; lower bound > +0.02 when difference is loss(Tk)-loss(A) => A_SUPERIOR; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
note: Synthetic infrastructure pilot; does not by itself establish claims about ChatGPT-wide metacognition or historical agency.
